subject: Avalon integration: MSA / DPA / SOW - contract alignment checklist
messages:

To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@avalon.io

Subject: Redwood integration - MSA/DPA/SOW templates and timeline

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Avalon Systems is ready to move forward with an integration pilot and procurement asked for our legal team to review Redwood's standard paperwork (MSA + DPA + SOW). Can you please send the latest templates and any standard security annexes?

Key constraints from our side:
- Data residency: production traffic must remain in us-west-2.
- Auditability: we need 12-month audit logs and SOC 2 evidence.
- Liability cap: procurement will request a higher cap for PII processing.

We'd like to close contracts before Jan 15 to hit our Q1 integration window.

Thanks,
Sarah

Head of Partnerships, Avalon Systems

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tang <sarah.tang@avalon.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-17T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood integration - MSA/DPA/SOW templates and timeline

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Attached are our most recent MSA and DPA. I also attached a one-page SOW template.

Quick callouts up front so your team can triage:
- We support regional routing; for a private deployment we can guarantee us-west-2 for production. Hosted API still routes by region but we can pin on Dedicated.
- SOC 2 Type II report is available; we provide audit logs for 12 months by default and can extend for enterprise.
- Our standard liability cap is $5M or 2x fees; I flagged this with legal if Avalon needs a higher cap.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Standard_2026.pdf, Redwood_DPA_2026.pdf, Redwood_SOW_Template.docx

Next steps I'd suggest: 1) Avalon sends redlines to the MSA/DPA/SOW; 2) we table high-risk items (liability cap, IP, data residency) for legal to review; 3) schedule a commercial sync this week.

Would Thursday morning PST work for a 30-min alignment?

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MSA_Standard_2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sarah Tang <sarah.tang@avalon.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@avalon.io, Joe Procurement <joe.procurement@avalon.io>
Date: 2026-12-18T08:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood integration - MSA/DPA/SOW templates and timeline

Thanks Ben — attached are our initial redlines for the MSA and a proposed SOW. High-level asks summarized below:

1) Liability & indemnity
- Request cap at $15M for breaches involving PII; carveout for gross negligence.

2) Data processing & residency
- Must restrict production data to us-west-2; contract should prohibit cross-region failover without Avalon consent.

3) Subprocessors
- Require 30-day notice for new subprocessors and right to object for high-risk categories.

4) Audit & compliance
- Annual SOC 2 with right to receive report within 30 days of request; 24 months of logs retained for security investigations.

5) IP & Deliverables
- Avalon requests explicit assignment of SOW deliverables and a usage license back to Avalon for jointly developed connectors.

We're flexible on standard warranty language but need clarity on the security annex scope.

Files attached: Avalon_MSA_redline_v3.docx, Avalon_SOW_v1.xlsx

Can you please route these to your legal team and let me know which items will require commercial approval? We're aiming for contract sign by Jan 10 if possible.

Cheers,
Sarah

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Avalon redlines - need legal + commercial input

Forwarding Avalon redlines. Key triage notes from my side:
- Liability cap: Avalon asks $15M for PII incidents. Procurement will escalate pricing if we take on that cap. Suggest legal propose a stepped cap tied to contract value or a carveout limited to direct PII processing.
- Data residency: engineering says we can pin production in us-west-2 for a Dedicated instance. For hosted offering we should propose a contractual commitment only for Dedicated.
- Subprocessors: standard 30-day notice + objection rights ok but expect pushback on blocking rights.
- IP: Avalon wants assignment for connector work. Product prefers a license-back model to avoid product entanglement.

Can legal advise on acceptable counterpoints and a recommended escalation path (commercial vs exec)? Laura/Karthik — flagged to you for SOW scoping impact and pricing.

Forwarded message below.

[Attachment: Avalon_MSA_redline_v3.docx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Avalon redlines - need legal + commercial input

Thanks for the context, Ben. I reviewed Avalon_MSA_redline_v3 and the SOW. Proposed approach and action items: 

Summary position (redlines we should accept):
- Notice of subprocessors and 30-day review period — accept with clarifying language for categories.
- SOC 2 Type II delivery and 12–24 months of logs — accept; clarify delivery timing and confidentiality terms.

Points requiring commercial/escalation:
- Liability cap: counter with a tiered cap: $5M standard, $15M limited to negotiated Dedicated engagements tied to minimum annual commit; include escrow for extraordinary incidents. This keeps Hosted lower risk.
- Data residency: contractually commit for Dedicated deployments only; provide contractual language that hosted endpoints "may" route regionally but cannot be guaranteed.
- IP assignment: propose license-back for connector deliverables with a transfer of ownership limited to customer-paid bespoke development.

Action items & owners:
- Kimberly: draft counter redline and proposed tiered liability language (due 2026-12-21 EOD).
- Laura: estimate uplift to pricing for $15M liability tier and updated SOW scoping (due 2026-12-22).
- Karthik: confirm engineering feasibility for Dedicated pinning + runbook for regional failover (due 2026-12-21).
- Ben: schedule commercial sync with Avalon for 2026-12-21 10:00 PST and confirm executive stakeholders if Avalon insists on $15M without an annual commit.

DocuSign envelope placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-avalon (for later)

I'll prepare a short executive summary for escalation if pricing impact is >15% of ARR for the deal. If so, we need to brief Revenue Ops and Legal Counsel.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Proposed_Counter_Liability_Wording.txt (txt)]
